proposals.reason: AI Omnibus Regulation entered into force in July 2026, formally delaying high-risk AI application dates.

card.t: AI Omnibus Regulation Enters into Force
card.x: Delays high-risk AI rules to Dec 2027 (Annex III sensitive use cases) and Aug 2028 (Annex I regulated products including MDR/IVDR). Immediate ban on non-consensual intimate content and CSAM generation.

proposals.reason: EN 18286:2026 QMS standard for AI Act published but not yet harmonised cited in OJEU.

card.x: AI Act QMS standard ratified and published by CEN/CLC/JTC 21. Harmonised citation in OJEU (conferring Article 17 presumption of conformity) still pending.

proposals.reason: Correcting publication date to July 2026 and confirming harmonised standard status under MDR/IVDR.

card.x: Harmonised ML risk management guide covering model drift, algorithmic bias, data quality and transparency. Applicable under MDR/IVDR for AI-based medical devices.

proposals.reason: Commission published transparency obligation guidelines for AI providers/deployers, in force August 2026.

card.x: Commission guidelines covering end-user information (chatbots, synthetic content), AI-generated content marking, and foundation model training summaries. Obligations apply from August 2026.

proposals.reason: Commission and ENISA published AI cybersecurity action plan with 2027 evaluation capacity rollout.

card.t: EU AI Cybersecurity Action Plan Published
card.x: Includes 2027 evaluation capacity funding, secure access blueprint for advanced AI systems, and dedicated testing platform for critical sectors (health, energy, finance).

proposals.reason: MHRA published AI Airlock Phase 2 report with practical AI evaluation recommendations for medical devices.

card.t: MHRA AI Airlock Phase 2 Report Published
card.x: Details AI medical device evaluation experiments with recommendations on performance characterisation, clinical evaluation, and post-market surveillance.

proposals.reason: Swissdamed and TGA traceability requirements became mandatory 1 July 2026.

card.x: Swiss Swissdamed database and Australian TGA traceability requirements now in force. Requires UDI synchronisation with EUDAMED for EU manufacturers exporting to these markets.

proposals.reason: ENISA published SBOM state-of-play report relevant to MDR/IVDR cybersecurity documentation.

card.x: Analysis of software bill of materials practices in the EU under Cyber Resilience Act and NIS2. Implications for medical device software component documentation under MDCG 2019-16.

proposals.reason: [REVIEW: description entierement reecrite — verifier que ce n'est pas un nouveau jalon qui devrait etre un add] AI Omnibus confirmed delay to 2 December 2027; removing 'if delayed' conditional from title.

card.t: AI Act High-Risk Annex III Application
card.x: High-risk AI systems in sensitive use cases (biometrics, critical infrastructure, education, employment, migration) must comply. Confirmed by AI Omnibus Regulation.

proposals.reason: [REVIEW: description entierement reecrite — verifier que ce n'est pas un nouveau jalon qui devrait etre un add] AI Omnibus confirmed delay to 2 August 2028; removing 'if delayed' conditional from title.

card.t: AI Act Annex I / Medical Devices Application
card.x: AI systems embedded in regulated products (MDR/IVDR medical devices, toys, elevators) must comply. Confirmed by AI Omnibus Regulation.
